Name: Seasonal Japanese Buildings
Author: sonreirblah
Description:
[center]-IF YOU WANT TO MODIFY THIS MOD IN ANY MEANS, SURE, GO AHEAD BECAUSE I HAVE NO TIME UPDATING/CHANGING IT ANYMORE, SORRY-


[img]https://i.imgur.com/OZyhVP4.png[/img][/center]

[list=1]
[*][b]Download the latest version of SMAPI, Content Patcher and Content Pather Animations.[/b]
[*]Download [i]Seasonal[/i] and [i]Animated[/i] Japanese files
[*][b]Unzip and place in your Mods folder.  ﻿DELETE THE MACOSX FOLDER, you don't need it. The folder should only contain: assets, manifest.json and content.json[/b]
[*]Start the game once to get a config.json file in the [i]Seasonal[/i] Japanese folder.
[/list][list]
[*]  Junimo Hut Alternative: true- set your Junimo Hut as a Bonsai Tree on a rock, not the Stone Lantern
[*]  Shed Alternative: true - set the Shed as a Tea House, instead of the Japanese store  
[*]Craftables: true - if you want to use my craftables   
[*]Static Well: true - if you don't want to use the animated well. ﻿
[/list]

[color=#fff2cc][center][size=3]Hi there! Thank you for showing support on the previous version. [/size][size=3]
[/size][size=3]Enjoy these Japanese-inspired farm buildings for your farm![/size][/center][/color]

[i][b]What's in here?[/b][/i]

-Buildings have minor changes every season

-Animated well (not very accurate tho). If you want a non-animated well, change the config.json "Static Well" to true/

-Animated Statues of Endless Fortune and Perfection. Get the non-animated Statues [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3536]here[/url]﻿.

-Junimo Hut Alternative (Bonsais growing on a rock)

-Shed Alternative (Tea House)

-Craftables!

[i][b]Currently working on:[/b][/i]

-Interior Furniture

-Interior Bathhouse for the Slime Hutch

[b]What [i]could be[/i] next?[/b]

-Japanese Clothing for NPCs

-Japanese Valley!

-A new Farm Map
